title: When the Choir Falls Revisited
author: Noor Eastwick
blurb: Zephyrine Hartwell, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
